name: Command Palette
description: ⌘K keycaps press, the app blurs back and a command palette drops in; typing filters the list as misses collapse under a fixed highlight, the selection glides down and up, Enter closes it and a confirmation toast springs up.
move: ⌘K keycaps press, the app blurs back and a command palette drops in; typing filters the list as misses collapse under a fixed highlight, the selection glides down and up, Enter closes it and a confirmation toast springs up.
how: GSAP timeline; the query text, placeholder and caret blink are painted from tl.time() in a timeline onUpdate. Misses collapse via height tweens (cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)), so hits reflow up under a highlight that does not move. Arrow/enter keys flash their footer keycaps. App layer filter blur(7px) brightness(.7) plus a veil and an accent bloom behind the palette.
adapt: Rename items and the query; mark matches with .item.hit / .item.miss and wrap matched characters in .m. Placeholder product names and copy are generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Timeline-driven: register the page's CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot and rebuild the timeline; state painted in onUpdate must stay a function of tl.time().
caveats: Original implementation; no third-party UI kit, product or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
